title: Herbes de Provence Roast Chicken Breast with Garlic Ratatouille
originalTitle: Ratatouille with garlic and herbs de provence roast chicken breast
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (or bone-in split breasts)
6 cloves garlic (4 smashed for ratatouille, 2 minced for chicken)
1 red bell pepper & 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped
1 can (14 oz) crushed San Marzano tomatoes (or 4 ripe Roma tomatoes, chopped)
Fresh basil leaves, kosher salt, and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Rub chicken breasts with 1 tbsp olive oil, minced garlic, 1 tbsp Herbes de Provence, salt, and black pepper.
In a large oven-safe skillet or braiser over medium-high heat, sear chicken breasts 3 minutes per side until golden; remove to a plate.
In the same pan, sauté onion, bell peppers, eggplant, zucchini, smashed garlic cloves, and remaining 1 tbsp Herbes de Provence in 1 tbsp olive oil for 8 minutes until softened.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes. Nestle the chicken breasts on top of the ratatouille and roast in the oven for 15–18 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F. Finish with fresh torn basil.
sourceTitle: Feasting at Home · Provençal Chicken & Ratatouille
